messages:
mike: kicking off canary for release r204 in the prod change window (03/07 22:00-23:00 UTC). plan: staged ramp to 100% over ~1h. initial traffic 5% -> 20% -> 100%. deploy-bot, run gating checks and reserve capacity. cc @sara @riya

deploy-bot: queued canary r204. running preflight: checking change-window conflicts, quota reservations, and canary_guard rules. results: no overlapping windows. autoscale policy OK. guard rule: first-step >10% requires explicit approval.

sara: quick Q — do we have recent perf for the same model family? last canary (r198) saw p95 spike at 5% under bursty traffic. link: https://telemetry.redwood/rollouts/r198 (ops dash)

riya: suggestion: start at 3% not 5%. add routing fallback to model-v1 if latency_p95 > 750ms. also add a 5m "grace window" between steps to observe KV cache warmup.

jonah: FYI console/API mapping: our A/B payload uses "variant_weight" as integers (0-100) but internal runtime accepts floats (0.0-1.0) too. can cause mis-applied splits if frontends send 0.03 vs 3. devex to confirm behavior.

natalie: ops note: reserved GPU pool "dedicated-1" has ~60% headroom for short bursts. dedicated commit throughput cap is 10k rps — current canary steady is well below that. making an audit entry for start and rollback policy. also want explicit rollback threshold: error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 > 750ms for two consecutive windows.

mike: updated rollout config (proposed):

```yaml
rollout:
  id: r204-canary
  steps:
    - duration: 15m
      traffic: 3
    - duration: 15m
      traffic: 12
    - duration: 30m
      traffic: 100
  guards:
    latency_p95_ms: 750
    error_rate_pct: 0.5
  fallback: model-v1
  grace_window: 5m
```

ops-bot: quota check complete — reserved capacity ticket #INC-4123 created, audit id audit-1971234580. No current change-window conflicts detected.

sara: ack. I'll approve after @jonah confirms the console -> runtime weight encoding. last thing we want is a 100x mis-translate. :thumbsup:

jonah: devex here — confirmed: runtime accepts both styles but console will normalize to integer percentages; we introduced a small conversion step to avoid float truncation. pushing a tiny fix to console so it emits ints always.

sara: approved. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: approvals received: 1/1 (required). scheduling canary start at 1971238200 (03/07 22:00 UTC). will emit telemetry hooks to /hooks/rollout/r204 and post p95/error-rate alerts to #incidents if thresholds breached.

mike: thanks all — monitoring dashboard link: https://telemetry.redwood/dashboards/r204-canary. please watch the p95 and 99th percentile tail, also cost signals for cross-region routing.

natalie: noted. will have on-call standby during the window.

mike: closing thread — will post rollup after the canary completes.
